title: Amazing experience!
text: Loved this much more than expected!  Your guide was so kind and friendly.  We went so many places that we could never go on foot in one day.  Segway was easy to manage.
author: Misty_M

title: The way to Segway
text: Carlos is a great trainer, guide, and host. Congenial, knowledgeable, and careful of his guests in traffic. A great 2 hour tour on 2 wheels. I am 78; you can too!!
author: Bill_A

title: Carlos Rocks It!
text: Carlos was a joy to ride along with—wonderful knowledge of Barcelona and sense of humor. He’ll teach you how to ride in 2 minutes. Loads of fun.
author: Ann_P

title: Best experience
text: Very nice and friendly, helpful; we were with Roni who showed us everything, thank you 😊
author: Ghodratollah_S

title: Fun time for the family
text: This was a lot of fun, and our guides were great! After a quick intro everyone was riding the Segways comfortably. It's a great way to see a lot of the city.
author: Chris_H

title: Barcelona Segway Style
text: Natasha was great in providing details of Barcelona and its history.  A fun way to see a lot of the city, without walking everywhere.
author: mark_c

title: Sagrada Familia Segway Tour
text: I believe the tour guide was Natasha?  She was great, made sure we were safe before traveling all around Barcelona on the Segways.  Allowed extra time to see the outside of Sagrada Familia and take photos but we were able to see alot of Barcelona due to being on the Segways.  I would highly recommend.
author: Carol_A

title: Segway tour
text: This is amazing tour!  Our tour guid was very knowledge with lots of fun facts of all our stops!  I had never ridden a Segway before.  With a couple of tries I picked it up and off we went.  Covered so much ground in Barcelona!  Natalia was awesome!! I highly recommend!
author: I8676EUdeborahk

title: Best tour experience ever!
text: This tour was AMAZING! Carlito was the best guide! He was funny and knowledgeable and very patient with my learning how to ride the Segway. My son and I only had really one day to explore Barcelona and so we opted for this tour. We really feel like we got to see all the best of the city with Carlos this way. His knowledge of the city and especially the Sagrada Familia cathedral are so impressive! I really cannot recommend this tour highly enough! It really is the best!
author: IowegianByMarriage

title: Fun tour to see and learn more of Barcelona
text: Kadyr showed us a lot of Barcelona on this tour and shared a lot of knowledge about the city. A 20-minute stop at Sagrada Family, so you could admire the beautiful structure itself on the outside.
author: Liliane_v
